messages.author: c3997138dbab4a1f
messages.subject: itemplot() shiny issue
parts:
Hi there! Greetings from Toronto.

We were at a training session and wanted to have people play around with itemplot(shiny=T). There seems to be a shiny specific issue, so I already apologize because probably not a mirt issue directly. However, some of us were getting the error "ERROR: [on_request_read] connection reset by peer" and the shiny app was not loading or loading with a grey shading and not producing a graph.

More of an FYI

R 3.4.2.
mirt 1.25
shiny 1.0.5
Windows 10 64gb
Chrome 61.0.3163.100

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: itemplot() shiny issue
parts:
Hmm, well it's definitely a shiny related issue. If you just use the default

mirt::itemplot(shiny=TRUE)

in Rstudio then it should open in their local web interface, and may
have less issues. Only when you pass

itemplot(shiny=TRUE, launch.browser=TRUE)

will the interface load in the default system browser.

Phil
